_doc: DEMO-POLISH playbook — how a human/agent closes the gap between plan-correct CSS and a design-matching demo. Builder MUST load this (node scripts/knowledge.mjs mechanism-polish) in style mode + fix mode. These are MECHANISM rules (overflow, clip, hover hosts, flex scrollports, CSS debt), NOT design-token values. Plan-style.json owns hex/px/radius; this file owns composed appearance.

doctrine.authority: Vision + live DOM beat plan prose when the composed UI is wrong. Screenshots (live vs mock vs Figma chrome) diagnose; computed styles + elementFromPoint confirm; mechanism CSS fixes; re-screenshot proves.
doctrine.prerequisite: Host wiring must already be live (knowledge/host-wiring.json + verify-host-wiring.mjs). Show-N replies / placeholders / page-mode composer cannot be polished into existence with CSS.
layers: VALUES — from plan-style / designSpec (first-shot-css). Never invent hex/px.
MECHANISM — overflow, min-height:0 scrollports, hover opacity hosts, Options.Trigger sizing, clone-wrapper flex, selected-state visibility. FREE to write/delete in styles.css during appearance + fix.
STRUCTURE — wrong slot/cardinality → BLOCKED_FOR_REPLAN, not CSS papering.
doctrine.innerLoop: Plan once → Build values → Mechanism polish (vision) → Judge → Strict-fix (Builder↔Judge). Do NOT replan because pixels look off.
doctrine.terminator: mechanism-checklist.mjs check exit 0 — not a flat diffCount plateau. Record results via mechanism-checklist.mjs init.
doctrine.cssDebt: When wireframe/structure changes (Options.Trigger moves, Reply becomes Body ToggleReply, etc.), DELETE or rewrite CSS that assumed the old tree. Stale collapse/hide/absolute rules are the #1 reason a correct wireframe still looks broken.

loop: 2. Screenshot the live surface next to the mock (and Figma for chrome).
3. Name the composed miss in one sentence (kebab invisible, Reply gone, list won't scroll, gap too large).
4. Probe the LIVE node (never 0-size *-wireframe twin): getBoundingClientRect, getComputedStyle, ancestry, elementFromPoint.
5. Identify the MECHANISM (clipped host, wrong opacity owner, flex min-height:auto, :has matching closed composer, body gap stacking).
6. Patch minimal mechanism CSS with !important; do not invent design values.
7. Hard-reload / bust CSS cache; re-screenshot; confirm the miss is gone and no regression on sibling states.
8. Log every beyond-plan mechanism fix in beyondPlan.json with evidence.

checklist.ask: On card/dialog hover, is the design kebab (Options.Trigger content) visible and clickable?
checklist.probe: Find .vc-options and .vc-options-trigger; check host width/height/overflow/opacity and whether Trigger is inside Options.
checklist.failIf: Host is 0×0, overflow:hidden clips Trigger, or options-trigger-container is zeroed/pointer-events:none while it hosts the design glyph.

checklist.ask: Unselected threads show Reply; selected (composer open) hide Reply without leaving a blank band.
checklist.probe: .vc-reply display + whether hide rules key on --selected vs composer presence.
checklist.failIf: Reply display:none on unselected cards, or empty gap between last comment and composer from a hidden-but-spaced ToggleReply.

checklist.ask: When threads exceed the rail height, the LIST scrolls; the rail does not clip with no scrollport.
checklist.probe: app-comment-sidebar-list / .vc-list scrollHeight vs clientHeight; min-height; flex; overflow-y; try scrollTop=200.
checklist.failIf: scrollHeight===clientHeight while content is clipped by .hw-rail overflow:hidden, or list grows unbounded (min-height:auto).

checklist.ask: Composer is one bordered pill (avatar+input+send), not nested double borders.
checklist.probe: Outer vs inner .velt-comment-dialog-composer borders; chrome scoped to the right dialog context.
checklist.failIf: Two visible rings, or page-mode chrome applied to reply composer.

checklist.ask: Gap between last comment and reply composer matches design (~8px body column), not stacked 16+16.
checklist.probe: Measure threads bottom → composer top; body gap vs threads gap.
checklist.failIf: Body and threads both use the card-list gap, or ToggleReply still occupies space when composer is open.

checklist.ask: Show N replies expands cards above the composer; cards do not overlap the composer.
checklist.probe: overlap of last card vs .vc-reply-composer; .vc-threads max-height.
checklist.failIf: SDK max-height (~230px) on threads forces later cards into the composer.

traps.symptom: Resolve shows on hover but kebab is missing after Options.Trigger correctly holds the design glyph.
traps.cause: Older CSS collapsed .vc-options to 0×0 + overflow:hidden and zeroed .options-trigger-container to hide the SDK ••• — that also clips the design Trigger now living inside Options.
traps.fix: Size .vc-options to the 16px kebab; overflow:visible; rest-hide via opacity on the Options HOST; hide ONLY svg.comment-dialog-options-dropdown-trigger; keep .options-trigger-container 16×16 + pointer-events:auto when it hosts .vc-options-trigger.

traps.symptom: ToggleReply is in the DOM but never visible on unselected threads.
traps.cause: :has(.vc-reply-composer:not([style*="display: none"])) matches every dialog — composer is hidden via CSS class, not an inline style attribute.
traps.fix: Gate Reply visibility on stable selected class (.velt-comment-dialog--selected), never on composer inline style presence.

traps.symptom: Sidebar content clipped at the rail; wheel/scrollTop does nothing.
traps.cause: Fixed mock height on velt-comments-sidebar + flex children with min-height:auto grow with threads; .hw-rail overflow:hidden clips; no element has scrollHeight>clientHeight.
traps.fix: Sidebar/panel height:100% + min-height:0 + overflow:hidden; .vc-list flex:1 1 0 + min-height:0 + overflow:auto as the scrollport; .velt-sidebar-content height:auto overflow:visible (content grows, list scrolls).

traps.symptom: Extra padding between last comment and reply composer.
traps.cause: Same gap:16px applied to both .vc-threads (card spacing) and .velt-body (section spacing), plus ToggleReply still in flow.
traps.fix: Threads keep card gap (design); body column uses tighter gap; hide ToggleReply when selected/composer open.

traps.symptom: Expanded replies overlap or sit under the reply composer.
traps.fix: On sidebar dialogs: height:auto; max-height:none; flex-shrink:0 on dialog→body→threads→cards chain so expand grows in flow above the composer.
